title: Add parents to the siblings tuple
description:
Modify the siblings tuple and add the name of your father and mother and assign it to family_members.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as add_parents(siblings, father, mother), where siblings is a tuple of names and father/mother are strings, returning a new family_members tuple with the father and mother appended after the siblings (tuples are immutable, so 'modifying' means building a new tuple).
hints: Tuples can't be changed in place - there is no append or add method - so 'adding' to one really means creating a brand new tuple.
You already know how to join two tuples together; father and mother just need to become a small tuple first.
Return siblings + (father, mother) - concatenating siblings with a two-item tuple of the parents' names.
expected_behavior: Returns a new tuple with father and mother appended after the siblings' names.
solution:
def add_parents(siblings, father, mother):
    return siblings + (father, mother)
explanation: Since tuples are immutable, there is no in-place way to add items; concatenating siblings with a new (father, mother) tuple produces the desired family_members tuple without mutating the original.
